name: devin
title: Devin
description: Launch and manage Devin sessions directly from Raycast
author: nikhil-cognition

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Devin API Token
preferences.description: Your Devin personal API key (starts with apk_user_)

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Custom Devin API endpoint (e.g. for enterprise or staging). Defaults to https://api.devin.ai

preferences.name: appBaseUrl
preferences.title: App Base URL
preferences.description: Custom Devin web app URL (e.g. for enterprise or staging). Defaults to https://app.devin.ai

preferences.name: userEmail
preferences.title: Your Email
preferences.description: Filter sessions to only show ones you created. Leave empty to show all org sessions.

preferences.name: useDevinReview
preferences.title: Open PRs in Devin Review
preferences.description: Open pull requests in Devin Review instead of GitHub/GitLab. Uses your App Base URL.
preferences.label: Use Devin Review

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Devin Session
commands.subtitle: Devin
commands.description: Launch a new Devin session with a prompt

commands.name: list-sessions
commands.title: List Devin Sessions
commands.subtitle: Devin
commands.description: View and manage your active Devin sessions

commands.name: menubar-sessions
commands.title: Devin Sessions Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Devin
commands.description: Show active Devin sessions in the menu bar
